Types

ColumnDef = object
  name*: string
  kind*: DataType
  nullable*: bool
  defaultValue*: string
DataType = enum
  dtNull, dtInt, dtFloat, dtBool, dtText, dtJson
ForeignKeyAction = enum
  fkaRestrict
ForeignKeyDef = object
  name*: string
  column*: string
  refTable*: string
  refColumn*: string
  onDelete*: ForeignKeyAction
PrimaryKeyMode = enum
  pkmManual, pkmSerial
RowData = OrderedTable[string, Value]
Value = object
  case kind*: DataType
  of dtInt:
    intVal*: int64
  of dtFloat:
    floatVal*: float64
  of dtBool:
    boolVal*: bool
  of dtText:
    strVal*: string
  of dtJson:
    jsonVal*: string
  of dtNull:
    nil
